$comment: Amalgamated anti-slop signatures for the check_slop MCP tool. Sources: shilp-sutra slop-corpus, Setu anti-patterns, impeccable absolute bans, 2026 web AI-slop tells, axe-style a11y. Deterministic (regex), no LLM. kind: 'line' (regex per line), 'count' (>=threshold matching lines), 'presence-without' (need present + missing absent). Escape: `// slop-allow: <id> <reason>` on the line or line above.

rules.fix: Solid colour; carry emphasis with weight or size, not a gradient fill.

rules.message: Purple/indigo/violet gradient — the #1 AI-generated colour tell.
rules.fix: Use the brand's real palette. If no brand colour, pick a deliberate, unexpected hue — not the default gradient.

rules.message: Raw colour literal bypasses the token system.
rules.fix: Use a semantic colour token, or mark a deliberate deviation with `// slop-allow: raw-color-literal <why>`.

rules.message: Side-stripe accent border (>1px left/right) — the single most recognizable AI card tell.
rules.fix: Full border, a background tint, a leading marker, or nothing.

rules.message: Near-black slate/zinc ground — the v0/Cursor dark-default signature (esp. with neon accents).
rules.fix: Match the brand's actual mode; if dark is right, warm/neutralise it to a chosen hue, never stock slate.

rules.message: Heavy backdrop-blur — glassmorphism-by-default reads generic unless flawless.
rules.fix: Solid, intentional surfaces; reserve blur for genuine layering over a real backdrop.

rules.message: Large blur — usually a decorative gradient orb/blob behind a hero.
rules.fix: One authored atmosphere (directional light, grained gradient in a brand colour), not floating blurred radials.

rules.message: Heavy drop shadow — depth-by-shadow on cards reads AI-default.
rules.fix: Depth from tonal elevation; reserve one subtle shadow for true overlays.

rules.message: Four-point sparkle / AI-magic glyph — brands the product as generic-AI.
rules.fix: An icon depicting the real action, or the brand's own mark.

rules.message: Oversized radius (24px+) — softens the UI into uniform blobs.
rules.fix: One radius vocabulary: ~10px cards, ~6px controls, pill for tags.

rules.message: Small uppercase tracked label — the eyebrow/kicker above a heading (2023-era AI scaffold).
rules.fix: Let the heading + size signpost the section; vary how sections begin. No eyebrows.

rules.message: Tracked-uppercase on 3+ roles — caps-on-everything reads as a template.
rules.fix: Caps for at most ONE deliberate role (e.g. data-table headers); mixed-case for the rest.

rules.message: Hover lift / scale ('boop') — a template reflex; controls shouldn't move on hover.
rules.fix: State change via a tonal colour shift; press feedback via active:scale-97, not hover-lift.

rules.message: `transition-all` animates every property (incl. layout) — janky, unfocused.
rules.fix: Name exact properties (transition-colors / transition-transform); use ease-out for entrances.

rules.message: Animation present with no reduced-motion fallback.
rules.fix: Honour prefers-reduced-motion (degrade to instant/crossfade); never gate content visibility on a reveal.
Add alt text (empty alt="" for decorative images).

deferred: filled-primary + outline-secondary button duo (needs sibling AST)
hero-metric template — big number + small label + gradient dot (needs structure)
identical icon-title-blurb card grids (needs repetition analysis)
safe-face identity (Inter/Roboto carrying the display) — needs font-role context
skipped heading levels h1->h3 (needs document order)
